g.title: pine
g.text: pine: one tree, one image that decides
a dashed border is an operating-system process of its own. every arrow across one
carries data and nothing else, so neither side can hang or crash the other

g.title: cluster_daemon
g.text: the daemon: one headless image, no display

g.title: cluster_agent
g.text: an agent: another image, here or on another machine

g.title: tree
g.text: every addressable thing is a node, reached by path
text, point, mark, mode, file, settings
what is shown where; a split is a write
a widget tree and whether it is up
what can be run, and what is running

g.title: values
g.text: fset in a box, no locks

g.title: ed
g.text: says its size and its font

g.title: faults
g.text: the thread stands where it broke
its restarts are what you take

g.title: cli
g.text: the same tree, from a terminal
